acceptanceCriteria: Every unbounded-readers registry entry carries a reason naming the unbounded read.
Units whose reads can be declared with AFP-V0-023 read-scope declarations get them, one unit at a time, each with a zero-new-miss replay over the 5 survey PRs.
The selection count on the replay is reported before and after.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Source: read-only rc.3 accuracy survey 2026-10-06 (origin/main 3dc863bd, installed rc.2 build 360) replaying merged PRs 571, 614, 594, 557, 610 at their merge-base. Harness and outputs: /private/tmp/claude-501/td-survey (local, not retained in the repository). affected had zero false negatives on all 5 PRs but low precision: PR614 and PR610 selected 51 against 4 needed, and PR557 52 against 3. UNBOUNDED_READER accounts for 37-40 of the selections in every PR, including cmd/corvint (about 591s). 34 of the 43 registry entries have no reason. Related: V1-0649, V1-0633, V1-0038, V1-0752.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#640 (rc3 batch 3), merged to main 2026-10-06T23:10:49Z as 0c27e35f48581601fbfaf9613d0216b5f8ca3a46. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-unbounded-reader-reasons.md and docs/decisions/0438-rc3-batch-3-requirements-accepted-2026-10-06.md at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; decision 0438 records the owner's acceptance of AFP-V0-033. The batch passed the full doc-gate CI list, the focused package tests and every hosted CI check on the merge head. NOT_RUN: make gate, -race, and live fleet qualification where the spec says so.

title: affected: 34 of 43 .corvint/unbounded-readers.json entries have no reason, and UNBOUNDED_READER drives most over-selection
